Hyena Attack Recovery

By: Tarryn Crossman | Production

Proposal


Show:

Further information:
Rodwell Nkomazana is a 9 year old Zambian boy who was mauled by a Hyena on the 7th of May. The Hyena basically ate away his face and he lost an eye. He was admitted to hospital in Zimbabwe, but they didn’t have the machinery or expertise required to handle such a massive reconstruction case. On the 14th of May one of the of medical staff in Zim contacted Maqshuda Kajee, an ER and flight Nurse, and asked her to help get Rodwell the medical care he needed in South Africa. She had no idea how to even go about finding the funds to help this little boy, but she became very close to Rodwell and his family, via the phone, and was determined to do what she could.
“I cried myself to sleep so many nights thinking about Rodwell and how if I didn’t get this right he may never be able to live a normal life again”

What followed was a series of miraculously interventions that got Rodwell and his mom to South Africa on a commercial flight with medical support staff and Maqshuda holding their hands. They arrived on the 17th of June and on the 22nd Rodwell had his first surgery. He has now undergone two massive reconstruction procedures under one of South Africa’s top plastic surgeons Dr Mia. On Saturday Rodwell will have his 10th birthday in hospital under strict quarantine rules. Due to the fear of infection and COVID-19 both him and his mom have had to be in isolation since their arrival at Netcare. He now has an upper lip so for the first time since the attack he is able to consume liquids through his mouth. He is still primarily being fed through a feeding tube though

It is such a hero story of how one woman couldn’t give up on this little boy that she had never even met in person and how this tiny little 9 year old boy has had to fight so hard for his life after a freak attack.
